description: This Java source file defines the 'UnknownChannelException' class, which is a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter module. The class represents an error scenario where a specific channel is not supported in combination with a given signal type. It includes a builder pattern for constructing instances with various metadata, and methods for creating exceptions from JSON objects. The class is marked as final and extends a runtime exception specific to Ditto, utilizing annotations for thread safety and JSON parsing.

classes.name: UnknownChannelException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when an unsupported channel is used with a specific signal, extending DittoRuntimeException. Includes static methods for creation from JSON and a nested builder class.

methods.description: Creates an instance of UnknownChannelException by extracting information from a JSON object.

methods.description: Overrides the method to set headers on the exception, returning a new instance with updated headers.

inner_classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of UnknownChannelException with customizable properties. Supports fluent API and is marked as thread-unsafe.
